verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity provider, so SSO for custom apps outside the catalog is a fair question. The pack, however, only has generic SSO concept text explaining that users authenticate once with an IdP to reach connected service providers. It has no evidence of custom SAML app setup, custom OIDC app setup, header-based app SSO, or step-by-step walkthroughs for apps outside the catalog. The OIDC mention concerns Cross App Access for AI agents, not configuring custom app SSO.
